steps.name: question (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Shainic] in the “Underground City of Tartarus”, go to [Elena] in “Coral City”.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Have you been resting well? Goddess's motherfucker♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's okay. Then I'll go get some more rest. Uh, but what do you have in your hand? letter?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I received a letter from you. Looking at the form, it’s not from Eastland… . Is this from another continent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a moment. Let me see and tell you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Looking around to see if Shinik has any intention of giving the letter to her in a nice manner.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: But who is this person, and why is he sealed in the shape of a heart?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You have a lot of questions.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I was already bored. So who are you? huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am a historian who studies the history of my ancestors in a city called Atlantis on the continent of Giandia. We study a city that disappeared due to an explosion under the sea in ancient times.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The name of the city is Coral City... . But then the city resurfaced near Atlantis.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I even went and helped.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah? By the way, is the city’s name Coral City? I think I heard it somewhere... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Is it time to die? Eh, I don't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They make all sorts of creepy jokes like that... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe, you can make jokes like this because you're like Shinic. Then keep talking. Funny, that guy… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's like an idol from Atlantis. She is so beautiful that all the men are lining up to ask her out on a date... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe it's because they are distant descendants of Coral City residents, but unlike others, they can enter the rediscovered Coral City.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The lives that came back to life as ghosts did not attack at all... . It's fascinating.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I heard you went in too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, under the protection of the goddess... .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Since you're not funny, read the letter and tell me what it's about. huh? huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There isn't much to talk about. Please read this letter and come to me, Jeongdo… .

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Eh, what is this! I expected something fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It can't be helped. Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yeah. If something interesting happens while you're there, be sure to tell me. Okay? You know what happens if you don’t know, right?♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes. all right. Don't worry, I'll come up with an interesting story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let’s go to Coral City for the first time in a while. I’m sure Elena is doing well, right?)

steps.name: question (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Stingray Assaulter] and [Ocellino] in “Twinkieb” and obtain <Genetic Magic Research Book> and <Magic Sea Droplet>. Then report to [Elena] in “Coral City”.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: What is this sound... ? Oh, it's him!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: It’s been a while, Adventurer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, did you know I was coming? You said it as if you were waiting... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I feel like the flow of the waves has changed with the appearance of Adventurer. Anyway, nice to meet you. long time no see!

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: The fact that you came here means that you received my letter, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It said it would tell me the secrets of Coral City, so I came quickly. It's definitely not normal, right?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Yes, that's right. It's not normal. Many people asked me to eat with them and go on dates, but I just couldn't do it.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: After I found out about this, I really, really couldn't do anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I think I discovered a different side of Coral City than I knew before. I was worried because it wasn't accurate.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Besides, it would be a bit difficult without Adventurer's help... . Thank you so much for coming.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You came like this because you didn’t forget me, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How should I answer this….)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: It's okay if you don't answer. Then I'll tell you what to do.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Perhaps this has something to do with the goddess Ceres... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Goddess Ceres?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'll be right back. What do you need?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: The story isn't over yet... . Thank you. What I need is... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Could you find the ‘Genetic Magic Research Book’ and ‘Magic Ocean Drops’ at Twinkiv and bring them to me?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Even though I am a descendant of Coral City residents, there are only so many places I can go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you called me.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Then I'll come back.

steps.name: question (3)
steps.objective: Defeat monsters in “Dragon Valley” and obtain <Fragment of Memory>. Then report to [Elena] in “Coral City”.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I remember getting this item for you a while ago.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You remember. that's right. However, as this item left Coral City, it somehow turned into powder and became useless.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh… . Something like that... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: So I had no choice but to bring the books and materials I had in my studio here.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: It won't be long before I tell you about something I've been working on.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Little by little, records of the ancient Coral City are emerging. However, there is something that doesn't seem like they are hiding something.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: There are a lot of clues, but they're blocked. It's as if the memories of this time have been locked away... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Has this book also lost its memories, or does someone just not want to show it?)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I think we need more magical elements... . Adventurer, do you know of any magic tool that can be used for this?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer? It looks like you know something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, speaking of memories, there is one thing that comes to mind. But I don't know if this will help with the book I brought to Elena.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Could you please help me one more time just in case? Maybe it's the goddess Ceres... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, in that case, I will come right away. Will you be here?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Of course. I will continue to be here. I'll wait for you, so please go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll go there and get you what you need.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You rush every time you say the name of the Goddess. Did something happen... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: It certainly seems like Adventurer shows off when he comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What tee?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: There is an ocean current that surrounds Coral City, but when Adventurer comes, it feels like the current is changing or shaking slightly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh? I don't know... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Really? I'm a little curious about how other people feel. The only people who can come in here right now are me and Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: There's something more important than that, so don't worry about it. So what did Adventurer get? ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if it will work, but could you show me the materials Elena has?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I don't know what you'll do, but I'm really looking forward to it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm just going to put this object here on top of the materials. Then it will find the answer on its own. I don't know if it will work or not... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just hope that you can believe it... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: It's an amazing thing.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: (Put a ‘fragment of memory’ on top of the data that Elena holds out. After a while, it emits a small light and seeps into the data that Elena has collected.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's done now... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Is it done?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, check it out.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: (Elena collects the data, looks through it, and becomes embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Little by little, things that were previously invisible begin to appear. What is this? Oh, no.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Hmm, hmm… . I think we can talk now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Actually, this research book was not created in ancient Coral City. This is a theory created in Atlantis just a few decades ago.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Do you know what happened in Atlantis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know. I did something wrong. But Coral City is an ancient city, so why…? .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Right, but isn't it strange? What the inhabitants of thousands of years ago had... . What if something from the future arrived across time?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: If the residents had these items, King Ocellino would not have been unaware of them.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: The king who wanted to be friends with everyone... . When the goddess Ceres disappeared, the underwater city disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Moreover, the stingray that had this was originally a normal fish, but it was strengthened and became the king's soldier, although we don't know for what reason.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I wish I had a little more clue... . Does anyone know anything about this phenomenon?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Feel the existence beyond time and space, and become more magically knowledgeable... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's someone I'm thinking of right now. Then can you wait? It's a bit far away... .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Yes, I will wait. In the meantime, I'll be looking at some more data.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Time and space... the only person who can talk about things like this is Siam, right?)

steps.name: Question (5)
steps.objective: Defeat [Ixion] in the “Room of Hell” and obtain the <Hero’s Gold Medal>. And report to [Siam].

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Welcome. Thank you for coming often.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Siam.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Seeing that you came to this space, I think it is definitely not a small matter.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Tell me. What kind of difficulty is there? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Siam about things related to Coral City.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I know that Coral City disappeared when the goddess Ceres disappeared. I also know that a genetic magic research book made with Atlantean technology was discovered in that city.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I can understand why historians are puzzled by that fact.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: But, what if... . Conversely, what would it be like if Atlantis' technology was based on ancient objects?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: What I say and what the historian says are all hypotheses. But I have no choice but to keep doubting... . There are more unknown things happening in this world than people think.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Everything that brought me here and you doing Iris sheep's work... , all those things.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Elena? If what he said was true, someone must have intervened.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: The power of someone with great power... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I suddenly became curious. But, I can't move here. I want you to help me one more time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I help you?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Please bring me the wizard's tools you brought me back then. I need to check once again the memories that were left behind in that tool.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Surely a great wizard in that land would have tools. Please… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll come back.

steps.name: question (6)
steps.objective: After talking to [Siam] in “The World Between Times”, go to [Elena] in “Coral City”.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. Then, I will recall the memories embedded in this object.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will wait for a while.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: (Siam nods his head and concentrates while holding the magician's tool. Little by little, Siam's eyebrows seem to narrow and harden.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Maybe Miss Elena's hypothesis is true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: The memories contained in the tool are honest. In particular, the tools of those with great power inevitably remember their owners.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: This tool is saying that its owner is a hypocrite. With the help of someone, he sacrificed those who wanted justice and became a hero.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know that... ?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: That's because it's left in this tool.  The person who gave power to the wizard is similar to me, but a little different.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Although I came from another world, I traveled across time and space. A being with that much power... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (With Siam’s words, someone’s image comes to mind. I met him not long ago at Lapier, the Tree of God….)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: You seem to be very afraid of something. It's okay, tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Siam about what happened in Adrica.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Ah, goddess… . I knew that beings from other worlds were trying to threaten this world, but to see that manifest directly... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Phew. If you need my help, come to me anytime. I will be happy to help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Siam… .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: And… Please speak appropriately to Coral City's historian. I'm not sure yet, so just tell me it's a possible hypothesis.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . Thank you, Siam. I will also find a way for Siam to get out of this space.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Thank you just for your words. Iris Please say hello to Miss too. And get plenty of rest. And go carefully.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Have you been there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You don't look good. What's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing happened.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: (Looking at your expression, it looks like you’re lying. I guess it’s no big deal.)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Have you been to the person you remembered? Someone you love?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, even a joke… . I'm just a wizard you know. Elena gave me some advice about her findings… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what did the wizard tell you? I hypothesized what would have happened if it were the other way around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What would it be like if Atlantis' technology was created based on ancient objects? .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: In ancient times, there was no technology to mutate genes. What if the change occurred through the power of God?

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Is there a being who can travel across time and space with god-like power? It seems like even the gods can't do that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Elena seems to know something. She's a pretty smart person. But I can't talk about it.)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Well, in ancient times, unbelievable things often happened.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Adventurer, I’m sorry. Originally, it was my job, but I guess I was trying to solve it easily by relying on Adventurer. And thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? When I went to meet him, I asked him a lot of questions that I didn't know. Thanks to you, it helped me a lot.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: Thank goodness. Then please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well then, take care, Elena.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to go back to Tartarus...)

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: You're definitely hiding something... . What is it? There were certainly places other than Coral City where strange phenomena occurred.

lines.speaker: 엘레나
lines.text: I heard about mountains and deserts. Let’s find out a little bit more.
